mapping_rationale: The gold benchmark explicitly marks the trajectory as drift and gives a drift_step onset; it is the closest reviewed source to GoalGuard's definition.
This is a trajectory-level misalignment label. It is aligned with the goal drift concept only when reviewed and uncontested; contested labels remain uncertain.
A negative trajectory-level label can serve as aligned/clean evidence only when the source label is reviewed and not contested.
Ambiguous, pending-review, or contested labels must remain separate from approved training targets.
Execution failures are not automatically goal drift. This source is retained for supplementary analysis only and excluded from model training.
